title: DOSA excluded_records product line
description: One excluded_records JSONL line per excluded window or metric (specification 0.1.0 section 11.5), with stable reason codes and enough coordinates to reproduce the decision. Window-level exclusions use metric="positional" (the delta_R/delta_RC pair is unavailable together under the canonical_only policy); metric-level exclusions name the exact k-mer imbalance field. An empty excluded_records.jsonl (zero lines) is a valid product asserting that no exclusion occurred. Field order is fixed as listed in required and is enforced byte-exact by the differential validator.
